concepts.label: Structural Intervention Distance (SID)
concepts.definition: A graph-based pre-distance that counts ordered intervention questions whose causal distributions are falsely predicted by an estimated graph relative to a true graph.
sub_questions: What role does Structural Intervention Distance (SID) play in SID?

concepts.label: Causal DAG
concepts.definition: A directed acyclic graph whose arrows encode the causal structure used to derive intervention distributions.
sub_questions: What role does Causal DAG play in SID?

concepts.label: Markov Factorization
concepts.definition: The factorization of a distribution into one conditional factor per node given its parents in a DAG.
sub_questions: What role does Markov Factorization play in SID?

concepts.label: Intervention Distribution
concepts.definition: The distribution of an outcome after a variable is forced to a value with the do-operator.
sub_questions: What role does Intervention Distribution play in SID?

concepts.label: Parent Adjustment
concepts.definition: The adjustment formula that averages an outcome conditional on the intervention over the intervened node's parents.
sub_questions: What role does Parent Adjustment play in SID?

concepts.label: Valid Adjustment Set
concepts.definition: A set that blocks the relevant non-directed paths without conditioning on descendants of nodes on a directed causal path.
sub_questions: What role does Valid Adjustment Set play in SID?

concepts.label: Structural Hamming Distance (SHD)
concepts.definition: A baseline graph score counting pairs of vertices whose edge type differs between two graphs.
sub_questions: What role does Structural Hamming Distance (SHD) play in SID?

concepts.label: Ordered Intervention Pairs
concepts.definition: The ordered pairs (i,j), with i not equal to j, that index the causal questions counted by SID.
sub_questions: What role does Ordered Intervention Pairs play in SID?

concepts.label: SID for DAG Estimates
concepts.definition: The definition of SID when the true graph and the estimated graph are both DAGs.
sub_questions: What role does SID for DAG Estimates play in SID?

concepts.label: Graphical SID Formulation
concepts.definition: A graphical characterization that evaluates parent sets and adjustment validity without computing densities.
sub_questions: What role does Graphical SID Formulation play in SID?

concepts.label: SID versus SHD
concepts.definition: The paper's comparison showing that edge disagreement and causal-effect disagreement can rank graph estimates differently.
sub_questions: What role does SID versus SHD play in SID?

concepts.label: Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG)
concepts.definition: A graph representing a Markov equivalence class of DAGs with compelled directed edges and reversible undirected edges.
sub_questions: What role does Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) play in SID?

concepts.label: SID Bounds for CPDAGs
concepts.definition: Lower and upper bounds that summarize SID behavior when an estimate is a CPDAG rather than one DAG.
sub_questions: What role does SID Bounds for CPDAGs play in SID?

concepts.label: Properties of SID
concepts.definition: The non-negativity, zero-identity, asymmetry, and non-triangle-inequality behavior that makes SID a pre-distance.
sub_questions: What role does Properties of SID play in SID?

concepts.label: Symmetrized SID
concepts.definition: A symmetric comparison obtained by considering SID in both graph directions when neither graph is designated as the estimate.
sub_questions: What role does Symmetrized SID play in SID?

concepts.label: SID Algorithm
concepts.definition: The efficient procedure that counts invalid causal predictions using adjacency, path, and reachability matrices.
sub_questions: What role does SID Algorithm play in SID?

concepts.label: Directed Path Matrix
concepts.definition: A matrix whose entry records whether one node is reachable from another by a directed path.
sub_questions: What role does Directed Path Matrix play in SID?

concepts.label: Non-directed Reachability
concepts.definition: The algorithmic representation of nodes reachable along non-directed paths that can remain open under an adjustment set.
sub_questions: What role does Non-directed Reachability play in SID?

concepts.label: SID Scalability
concepts.definition: The runtime behavior of the SID computation as graph size and sparsity change.
sub_questions: What role does SID Scalability play in SID?

concepts.label: Linear-Gaussian Effect Check
concepts.definition: The appendix's analytic setting for checking causal effects from known structural coefficients and noise variances.
sub_questions: What role does Linear-Gaussian Effect Check play in SID?
